captions.story: Could you survive the crushing pressure at the bottom of the Indian Ocean?

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of the Diamantina Trench?
story.summary: This episode explores the Diamantina Trench in the Indian Ocean, examining its extreme depth, crushing pressure, resilient snailfish, and underwater avalanches. It highlights how little we know about Earth's deepest trenches.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of the Diamantina Trench?
